title: Lamb Pilaf with a Zesty Twist
description: A flavorful and refreshing twist on traditional lamb pilaf, infused with the bold flavors of the Mediterranean.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt, pepper, and zesty seasoning.
Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides.
Remove the lamb from the pot and set aside.
Add the garlic to the pot and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the pilaf rice to the pot and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of water to the pot and stir to combine.
Return the lamb shoulder to the pot, cover, and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the lamb is cooked through and the rice is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the lemon juice.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot, garnished with chopped parsley.
